meta.title: Pre-NFP morning: 10Y at 5.34%, Broadcom's $42B Anthropic financing
meta.channel: Grow your WEALTH - Valentin Dragu si Alex Marian
meta.thread_line: 6 threads: the 24-year 10Y high and reversal, oil/dollar tightening, Broadcom-Anthropic financing, portfolio updates, space backlog, and an NFP playbook

snapshot: The 10Y hit **5.342%** intraday on Oct 1, the highest since 2002, then reversed as buyers stepped in and Fed Vice Chair Jefferson signaled patience; indices closed slightly green.
Fed hike odds for October fell to ~28% from ~69% a week earlier; Goldman moved its next-hike forecast from October to December.
Economy keeps resisting: claims 197k (near 57-year lows), ISM Manufacturing 54.5, but input prices accelerated, which hurts bonds.
Oil and dollar tighten without the Fed: Brent ~$102.60 (+14% in September), China suspended fuel exports, DXY ~102.08 is a 17-month high.
Broadcom may provide up to **$42B** financing to Anthropic; Valentin sees a mixed signal (volume vs circular credit risk).
He plans to add to SPCX, AVGO, RKLB, ASTS and even NBIS on his own price conditions, not on the calendar.
NFP playbook: watch the 10Y reaction after the number, not the first Nasdaq tick; three scenarios with Goldilocks at 70-120k.

themes.title: The 10Y touched 5.34% and bounced: Fed isn't the only problem
themes.lead: Buyers defended the long end after a 24-year high, which Valentin reads as constructive but not final.
bullets: Closes: S&P 500 7,666.48 (+0.20%), Nasdaq 26,871.60 (+0.04%), Dow 50,926.74 (+0.04%). The 10Y reached **5.342%** intraday (highest since 2002), the 2Y fell ~10 bps (biggest daily drop since August 2025). Morning of Oct 2: 10Y ~5.25%.
Fed: Vice Chair Philip Jefferson and John Williams suggested patience; Goldman moved the hike call from October to December. October hike odds ~28% vs ~69% a week earlier.
The 10Y includes Fed expectations, future inflation, real yield, term premium, issuance and fiscal risk; the same repricing shows in France, UK, Germany and Japan.
His thresholds: below 5.20% real relief for growth; 5.20-5.30% high but manageable stress; 5.30-5.35% critical; above 5.35% with confirmation multiple compression can accelerate.

quote.text: Fed nu mai este singura problema.

themes.title: Strong data, hot input prices, oil and dollar tighten conditions
themes.lead: Good economic news is not automatically good for stocks: it can mean higher yields and lower multiples.
bullets: Initial claims 197k (consensus 200k, near 57-year lows); ISM Manufacturing 54.5 vs 54.6 in August, but the prices-paid component accelerated.
Brent ~$102.60, WTI ~$93.14 after China suspended fuel exports and US-Iran tension plus extra US military assets in the Gulf; Brent +~14% in September.
The IMF notes refined products up ~60-97% (diesel, gasoline, jet fuel) given limited refining capacity, which drives consumer-felt inflation.
Dollar Index ~102.08 (17-month high, ~+1% on the week): dollar, yields and oil up equals tightening without the Fed acting.
Breadth: advancers/decliners 1.23:1 NYSE, 1.04:1 Nasdaq; Nasdaq made 287 new 52-week lows vs 41 highs. Energy led (+1.9%), Technology +~0.8%, Micron +3%, Accenture results supported software.

themes.title: Broadcom's up-to-$42B Anthropic financing changes the risk analysis
themes.lead: Bullish on volume, but vendor financing adds circular credit and concentration risk.
bullets: Per Anthropic's IPO documents, Broadcom agreed to up to **$42B** of financing for leasing its chips, ~a third of Anthropic's $125.2B five-year TPU/custom-compute commitment.
Anthropic is expected to become Broadcom's largest chip-design customer by 2027; Broadcom anticipates AI chip revenue of ~$115B in 2027 and ~$230B in 2028.
Upside view: AVGO can reach AMD's level, an 80-100% gain by end of 2028, his target for each new sum invested. Downside: if Anthropic's economics deteriorate, AVGO could go below $250.
Stock traded under $350 intraday, ~$347-350; $346-350 is key, below it $338-342; $360-365 needed to restart momentum.
He doesn't treat the financing as automatically bullish; the verdict is ROIC and cash flow. In a >5% yield world $42B demands a return.

quote.text: Nu tratez aceasta finantare automat drept bullish. Verdictul vine din ROIC si cash-flow.

themes.title: AMD, Tesla, Meta, Palantir, Nebius and the rest of the book
themes.lead: At 10Y yields above 5%, he asks every holding for monetization and return on capital.
bullets: **AMD** ~$610: World Labs ($8.2B) is optionality, but HPE got a ~$1.2B order from Vultr for AMD Helios racks (MI455X) which is monetization now. Support $596-600, $615-625 to recover, ~$639 resistance. He earns ~$10-12k/month selling 15 covered calls at strikes >15% above spot, seeing no path to $700 soon.

**Tesla** ~$355-356: stronger European registrations in September; one good month is not a trend. $355-360 critical, $340-345 below, $372-375 above; Roadster event moved to Oct 15; Robotaxi and FSD matter more.

**Meta**: no big catalyst; self-funds AI from ads cash flow. Support $700-715, resistance $750, then $775-780. **Palantir** ~$185-190: de-rating risk at 5%+ yields; support $182-185, resistance $194-195.
**Nebius** acquired Inferize (production-scale AI inference) to fight the 'idle GPU tax' and raised some compute prices from Oct 1; support $225-230, resistance $247-250.

**SoFi** (claims 197k help credit quality, 5% yields hurt capital cost, $15.50-16 support), **Robinhood** (volatility helps; risk is a 10Y up, Nasdaq down, Bitcoin down combo; $112-116 support) and **IREN** (needs Bitcoin up and 10Y down; $40-42 support, $45-46 to recover).
**Centrus**: HALEU thesis intact, $135-140 critical, $147-150 first better signal. **Ondas**: no material news, watch share count; support $7.20-7.40, resistance $8-8.20.
Anecdote: his personal trainer bought a Model 3 Long Range; he expects EV demand with pricey fuel, with wealthier buyers choosing Tesla.

themes.title: Rocket Lab's record Electron deal, SpaceX cadence, ASTS hires
themes.lead: Space delivers contracted backlog, and he plans to add on his own price levels.
bullets: Rocket Lab signed Synspective's largest Electron deal: 20 launches in 2028-2031, 47 launches total with that client; contracted missions exceed 100. Citi initiated at Buy, target **$105**, calling it a core holding.
RKLB closed ~$70.56; support $68-70, resistance $75-76, then $80.

SpaceX: NASA Crew-13 and a Falcon Heavy for a classified National Reconnaissance Office mission scheduled, and Transporter-18 carrying 100+ spacecraft; Starship repeatability after Flight 14 is the key KPI.
ASTS hired a chief commercial officer from Google Fi and SiriusXM; shareholder litigation exists but isn't treated as operational damage yet. Support $58-61, resistance $65-68.
themes.watch: Valentin applies the space thesis 'aggressively' across his portfolios and says Citi confirmed it.

themes.title: NFP playbook: watch the 10Y, not the first Nasdaq tick
themes.lead: He plans to add SPCX, AVGO, RKLB, ASTS and NBIS only at prices and conditions he set.
bullets: Consensus ~100,000 jobs and 4.2% unemployment after 162,000 in August.
Goldilocks 70-120k with unemployment 4.1-4.2% and moderate wages: lower hike odds, lower 2Y/10Y, growth benefits.

Hot (above ~150k, unemployment 4.0-4.1%): hike back in play, 10Y can retest 5.34-5.35%. Weak (below 50k or negative, unemployment 4.3%+): bond rally first, then equities ask if the problem moved to growth, and SoFi and consumer names need scrutiny.
Key tell: a strong NFP with a 10Y that can't break 5.34% means bond selling is tiring; a moderate NFP with the 10Y above 5.35% means a structural fiscal problem.
Today's allocation across IBKR, GYW and GYW500 is aimed at SPCX, AVGO, RKLB, ASTS and NBIS, under conditions and prices he set. He adds that he buys nothing just because it is October 2.

quote.text: Nu ghicim cifra, nu alergam dupa primul candle si nu confundam volatilitatea cu o schimbare de fundamental.

takeaways.title: Read the 10Y after NFP: failure to break 5.34% on a strong print signals bond-selling fatigue.
Follow refined products (diesel, jet fuel), not just Brent, for real inflation pressure.
Treat dollar strength plus rising yields plus oil as tightening even when the Fed stands still.
Judge Broadcom's Anthropic financing on ROIC and cash flow, not on the headline size.
Never gauge risk from the S&P level: 287 Nasdaq lows sat under a green index.

hot_takes.take: Eu cred ca actiunea poate ajunge fara probleme la nivelul la care se afla AMD astazi, adica un potential de 80%-100% crestere pana la final de 2028.
Intr-un astfel de scenariu eu cred ca am putea vedea AVGO sub $250.
